runners.name: Safari Dream
runners.spotlight: Recorded his seventh win, at Salisbury (6f, good) in May off 3lb lower and has performed with credit on his last two starts; cheekpieces return although he has never won in them; has won off higher marks than this and should run his race.
runners.comment: Recorded his seventh win, at Salisbury in May off 3lb lower.

runners.name: Monsieur Patat
runners.spotlight: Has seven wins to his name and shaped well when placed on his first two starts this year; never figured when favourite at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in June but race may have come too soon and dangerous to dismiss.
runners.comment: Never figured when favourite at Windsor in June but race may have come too soon.

runners.name: The Feminine Urge
runners.spotlight: All three wins came when trained by George Scott; has tumbled down the weights since but has found her level seemingly when placed at Newbury (6f, good to firm) and Lingfield (6f, good to firm) last month; could be dangerous off her low weight.
runners.comment: Placed at Newbury and Lingfield last month; could be dangerous off her low weight.

runners.name: Escape Plan
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at Kempton (6f, AW) in March; didn't look in love with the track when down the field at Windsor subsequently and a line can also be put through his last run at Bath when he was almost brought down when about to deliver his chance; not one to give up on.
runners.comment: Off the mark at Kempton in March and had excuses for last two defeats.

runners.name: Diamondinthedark
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in November, but last of eight on belated seasonal return/handicap debut at Lingfield (7f, AW) in June; needs to get back on track on this turf debut.
runners.comment: Last of eight on belated seasonal return/handicap debut at Lingfield in June.

runners.name: Newsreader
runners.spotlight: All three wins came over 7f at Kempton AW in 2024 when trained by Kevin Philippart De Foy; has had no success with Edward Smyth-Osbourne since and makes stable debut for shrewd yard off a career-low mark; market will be best guide.
runners.comment: All three wins came over 7f at Kempton AW in 2024 when trained by Kevin Philippart De Foy.

runners.name: The Coffee Pod
runners.spotlight: Both wins came at York when trained by Richard Hannon; denied a clear run when finishing fifth of ten at Sandown (6f, good to firm) ten days ago; has dropped to a career-low mark but may be getting his act together.
runners.comment: Denied a clear run when finishing fifth at Sandown ten days ago.

runners.name: Avionics
runners.spotlight: Stepped up from his debut when runner-up at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) last month; in good hands and should go close.
runners.comment: Stepped up from his debut when runner-up at Salisbury last month.

runners.name: Perfect Nation
runners.spotlight: Looked a nice prospect when making all at Lingfield (7f, AW) on his second start; shoulders a 7lb penalty here but will be difficult to pass and holds solid claims.
runners.comment: Looked a nice prospect when making all at Lingfield on his second start.

runners.name: Midgham Man
runners.spotlight: Ran green but finished off well when fifth of seven on his debut here (6f) in June; needs to build on that, stepping up in trip.
runners.comment: Ran green but finished off well when fifth on his debut here in June.

runners.name: George Cross
runners.spotlight: 200,000euros yearling; first foal; by Wootton Bassett; unraced dam closely related to 8.6f winner Kalidasa, out of 1m2f Group 3 winning sister to 7f/1m Group 1 winner Too Darn Hot, is granddaughter of 1m2f/1m4f Group 1 winner from high-class family; in good hands but yard going through a quiet spell at present; market will be best guide.
runners.comment: In good hands but yard going through a quiet spell at present; market will be best guide.

runners.name: Artemis Star
runners.spotlight: Showed ability when fifth of 12 on his debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month; steps up in trip and may be capable of better.
runners.comment: Showed ability when fifth on his debut at Windsor last month.

runners.name: First Mate
runners.spotlight: Never got competitive when seventh of ten on his debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last month; steps up in trip and may well show improvement.
runners.comment: Never got competitive when seventh on his debut at Newbury last month.

runners.name: Revoked
runners.spotlight: Beaten 11l on his debut at Newbury (7f, good to firm) last month; looks one for the future.
runners.comment: Beaten 11l on his debut at Newbury last month.

races.race_name: Ken Meredith Memorial Race Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Cypriot Diaspora
runners.spotlight: Recorded back-to-back wins over C&D last August; has been below that level since although she ran better when third over C&D when last seen in June; has dropped to a career-low mark and course record holds her in good stead; possibilities.
runners.comment: Recorded back-to-back wins over C&D last August; has been below that level since.

runners.name: Bird Of War
runners.spotlight: Hosed up at Newcastle (1m, AW) last November off 8lb lower; best run since when third back there (7f) in June; has possibilities if he can translate that form to turf on which he is yet to be placed from six starts.
runners.comment: Hosed up at Newcastle last November; best run since when third back there in June.

runners.name: Sofian
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark when landing this equivalent race (good) last August off 1lb lower; hasn't been beaten far twice over C&D this summer and cannot dismiss.
runners.comment: Got off the mark when landing this equivalent race last August off 1lb lower.

runners.name: Grand Vista
runners.spotlight: Has shown glimpses of ability, such as when fourth on his debut at Newbury (6.5f, soft) last October, and when third at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) last month, but below that level at Wolverhampton since; first-time cheekpieces now on and not one to give up on.
runners.comment: Has shown glimpses of ability, such as when third at Chepstow last month.

runners.name: Ebn Sabt
runners.spotlight: Has failed to beat a rival in three starts for this yard this year; change of headgear but can't consider.
runners.comment: Has failed to beat a rival in three starts for this yard this year.

runners.name: Thestral
runners.spotlight: Won a Newcastle novice (7f, AW) for Hugo Palmer in December; placed in handicaps at Lingfield (7f, AW) and Wetherby (1m, good to firm) in final two runs for that yard but he struggled on last month's stable debut at Kempton; still lightly raced but his form has been up and down so far and others are preferred; first-time cheekpieces worn last time are persevered with.
runners.comment: Won a Newcastle novice for Hugo Palmer in December; form up and down since.

runners.name: Laughterintherain
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in Lingfield novice (7f, AW) last December on third start; soundly beaten in three handicaps this season; others have more compelling claims.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Lingfield last December; soundly beaten in three handicaps this season.

runners.name: Lerwick
runners.spotlight: Both wins at around 1m when trained by Ed Bethell; his losing run is mounting up and a first-time eye-shield is now applied along with returning blinkers; now on a career-low mark but doesn't look ready to take advantage.
runners.comment: His losing run is mounting up and a first-time eye-shield is now applied.

runners.name: Our Dagger
runners.spotlight: Both wins came on AW in early-2025 when trained by Daragh Bourke; hasn't run to that level since and now with his sixth trainer; best watched at present.
runners.comment: Both wins came on AW in early-2025; hasn't run to that level since.

races.race_name: Ken Meredith Memorial Race Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Piazza
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden; made quite promising seasonal debut when fifth of 12 at Kempton (7f, AW) in June but her return to turf last month was underwhelming; others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Her return to turf last month was underwhelming; others have more pressing claims.

runners.name: Kaleidoscope Eyes
runners.spotlight: Scored over C&D (heavy) off this mark last September; showed she was on the way back when beaten a neck over C&D (good) last month and should be in the firing line.
runners.comment: Showed she was on the way back when beaten a neck over C&D last month.

runners.name: Rosemary's Rose
runners.spotlight: Both wins came on AW at the beginning of the year and is knocking on the door at present, having been placed on her last three starts; Oisin Murphy rides for the first time and must go close.
runners.comment: Both wins came on AW at the beginning of the year and is knocking on the door at present.

runners.name: March Of Time
runners.spotlight: Best of her three runs was on debut when third at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in June; hood worn last time is persevered with on handicap debut and no surprise were she to show significant improvement.
runners.comment: Best of her three runs was on debut when third at Windsor in June.

runners.name: Iconic Dawn
runners.spotlight: Some promise over 6f as a 2yo but her three handicap runs have been poor; first-time blinkers need to have a positive effect.
runners.comment: Some promise over 6f as a 2yo but her three handicap runs have been poor.

runners.name: Cosmic Jive
runners.spotlight: Has shown little this term in maiden/novice races; still early days and no surprise were he to show considerable improvement on this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Has shown little this term in maiden/novice races; could improve on handicap debut.

runners.name: Venturing
runners.spotlight: Didn't offer much in three runs for Donnacha O'Brien, and fared even worse when last of four on stable/handicap debut at Newbury (1m, good to firm) last month; still early days but needs to show considerable improvement.
runners.comment: Last of four on stable/handicap debut at Newbury last month.

runners.name: Speculative
runners.spotlight: Has shown little in her four runs, including when ninth of 14 at Salisbury (7f, good) on handicap debut when last seen in May; needs to do much better.
runners.comment: Has shown little in her four runs, including when ninth at Salisbury in May.

runners.name: Manhattan Mirage
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden who was below form in five runs last year and showed little on his return at Bath in June; his mark continues to drop but is best watched until showing positive signs.
runners.comment: 13-race maiden who was below form in five runs last year and on his return in June.

runners.name: Arbaawy
runners.spotlight: Fair maiden who has been running well in handicaps this year, making the frame on four of his five starts; has the edge on experience and goes without cheekpieces worn on last three starts; should win sooner or later.
runners.comment: Fair maiden who has been running well in handicaps this year.

runners.name: Flagbearer
runners.spotlight: 485,000gns yearling; first foal; by Sea The Stars; dam unraced half-sister to winners Cannock Chase (Canadian 1m4f Grade 1), Star Catcher (Irish Oaks) and Pisco Sour (1m2f Group 2), out of maiden half-sister to 1m1f Group 2 winner Lord Admiral; well bred and yard in excellent form; already gelded and must be of interest on this debut.
runners.comment: Well bred and yard in good form; already gelded and must be of interest on this debut.

runners.name: Wootz
runners.spotlight: Second foal; by Wootton Bassett; half-brother to French 9.5f AW/10.5f turf winner Marchon; dam French Listed-placed 1m4f winner (RPR 100), sister to US 1m1f Grade 3 winner Luck, half-sister to Group 3 winners Goldwaki (1m4f) and Golden Valentine (12.5f); yard in irresistible form at present and needs to considered on this debut.
runners.comment: Yard in irresistible form at present and needs to considered on this debut.

runners.name: Mountain Of Light
runners.spotlight: Has shown just modest form so far at Haydock and Newbury and may have more to give once she goes handicapping.
runners.comment: Has shown just modest form so far at Haydock and Newbury.

runners.name: Vincenzo Bellini
runners.spotlight: The first foal of Moyglare Stud Stakes winner Shale, he finished his race off nicely after a tardy start when fifth of eight on his debut over C&D (good) in June and should improve.
runners.comment: Finished his race off nicely after a tardy start when fifth on his debut over C&D in June.

runners.name: Fallen Logic
runners.spotlight: Beaten 25l and 28l on both starts so far; easy to look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Beaten 25l and 28l on both starts so far; easy to look elsewhere.

runners.name: Herstmonceux
runners.spotlight: Gelding by Ulysses; tenth foal; half-brother to winners Timothy T (7.6f 2yo; RPR 92), Poetic Light (7.7f 2yo; 83), Suitsus (6f AW/1m turf; 74) and Equal Point (6f AW; 66); dam unplaced 6.5f/7f 2yo (35), out of sister to 1m2f/2m Listed winner Upper Strata; watching brief advised on this debut.
runners.comment: Watching brief advised on this debut.

runners.name: Stopherandgo
runners.spotlight: A fair hurdles winner for Claire Harris in 2023 but this veteran mare offered little over hurdles and fences for Kevin Pickard last season; always behind on belated Flat debut at Kempton last month.
runners.comment: Always behind on belated Flat debut at Kempton last month.

runners.name: Mythological Star
runners.spotlight: He's improved with each of his three runs, finishing third at Lingfield (7f, good) on his second outing and getting closer to the target when occupying the same position there (1m, AW) last time; his useful pedigree provides optimism that he will continue to progress; respected.
runners.comment: Handicap debut; his useful pedigree provides optimism that he will continue to progress

runners.name: Hurricane Laughter
runners.spotlight: Unable to live up to his market billing when unplaced this summer in his first two handicaps (1m, good/good to firm) and improvement is needed; however, he has a useful pedigree and represents an in-form yard, and things may click at some point.
runners.comment: Improvement needed but has useful pedigree and things may click at some point

runners.name: Station Bar
runners.spotlight: He got off the mark at the ninth attempt in a three-runner handicap at Bath (1m, firm) in May; however, well beaten at Salisbury (1m, good to firm) since and he needs to settle better today.
runners.comment: Off mark at ninth attempt in three-runner h'cap at Bath but well beaten at Salisbury since

runners.name: Gelato
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish filly who was going beyond 6f for the first time when winning here (7.3f, soft) in June on her second stable start; 7lb higher today and on different ground, but she had 3l in hand last time and could have more to offer at this sort of trip; key player.
runners.comment: Went beyond 6f for the first time when winning by 3l over 7.3f here last time; key player

runners.name: Somethingintheair
runners.spotlight: Ran three times towards the end of last year and showed ability, finishing a close fifth at Lingfield (1m, AW) last December; absent since but makes handicap debut with yard going well and she's not ruled out.
runners.comment: Makes handicap/seasonal debut with yard going well and she's not ruled out

runners.name: Condotti
runners.spotlight: 0-13 but has been placed on his last two runs; a visor replaces cheekpieces on this step up in trip and Oisin Murphy rides for the first time; plenty of positives and should go close.
runners.comment: 0-13 but has been placed on his last two runs; Oisin Murphy rides for the first time.

runners.name: Beaune
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been on AW; respectable fourth over C&D (good) in June but seems best suited to AW.
runners.comment: Respectable fourth over C&D in June but seems best suited to AW.

runners.name: A Daughters Love
runners.spotlight: Won twice this summer at Chepstow (1m2f, good to firm) and Leicester (1m2f, good to firm); out of her depth at Ascot last time but holds claims back at this more realistic level.
runners.comment: Out of her depth at Ascot last time but holds claims back at this more realistic level.

runners.name: Grindleton
runners.spotlight: 0-6 but had been showing promise prior to running at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) in June when things didn't go to plan; he may be worth another chance after a short break.
runners.comment: Things didn't go to plan at Wolverhampton last time and he may be worth another chance.

runners.name: Jimmy Mark
runners.spotlight: Has two course wins over 1m2f; has run well on all three starts this summer but is 4lb above his last winning mark and remains vulnerable.
runners.comment: Has run well on all three starts this summer but is 4lb above his last winning mark.

runners.name: Ada Rose
runners.spotlight: Showed improvement when getting off the mark at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) in June; needs to show that she can act as well on turf off 6lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Showed improvement when getting off the mark at Wolverhampton in June.

runners.name: Houndswood Willow
runners.spotlight: 0-6 and closest he's got to the winner was when beaten 3l at Chepstow (1m4f, good to firm) last month; has something to build on but needs more.
runners.comment: 0-6 and closest he's got to the winner was when beaten 3l at Chepstow last month.

runners.name: Praise Indeed
runners.spotlight: 0-5 but posted a much-improved effort when runner-up here (1m2f, good) last month on second start for this yard; steps up in trip and there may be more to come.
runners.comment: 0-5 but posted a much-improved effort when runner-up here last month.
runners.owner: Mrs R F Greener And North Farm Stud

runners.name: Pomeriggio
runners.spotlight: Regressive, ex-Irish mare who showed no benefit for five months off at Chepstow in June after a couple of poor efforts on the AW in the winter; little to recommend her this time.
runners.comment: Modest form after five months off at Chepstow in June.

runners.name: Cartrefle
runners.spotlight: Has finished last on all three starts; has been gelded since his last run and sports first-time cheekpieces on this step up in trip on handicap debut; needs to show massive improvement here.
runners.comment: Has finished last on all three starts; needs to show massive improvement here.

races.race_name: Army Benevolent Fund/EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Palace Legacy
runners.spotlight: Fared best of the three newcomers when third of five at 6-1 on last month's debut at Epsom (7f, good to firm); this half-brother to four winners is open to improvement and holds leading claims.
runners.comment: Promising third of five on last month's debut at Epsom and holds leading claims

runners.name: National Pride
runners.spotlight: 10-1, beaten about 9l when sixth of eight on last month's debut at Ascot (7f, good to firm); however, this 72,000gns breeze-up buy represents a top Newmarket trainer who is 7-15 (47%) here in the last five seasons; could take a big step forward and play a major role.
runners.comment: Down the field at Ascot on debut but Newmarket trainer has a fine strike-rate here

runners.name: Waakabb
runners.spotlight: He was behind two experienced rivals, including a longer-priced stablemate, when 3l third of 12 at 15-8 on debut at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) last month; this 175,000euros breeze-up buy is a likeable prospect; high on the list.
runners.comment: Behind two experienced rivals when third on debut; likeable prospect; high on the list

runners.name: A La Montagne
runners.spotlight: First foal of connections' 1m4f Arc winner Alpinista; it's possible this Dubawi newcomer will need more time and distance but her dam won over 7f on her 2yo debut; Newmarket stable 5-17 (29%) here in the past five seasons; intriguing contender, all the more so if strong in the betting.
runners.comment: First foal of connections' 1m4f Arc winner Alpinista, who won over 7f on her 2yo debut

runners.name: Breaking The Habit
runners.spotlight: Third foal; Dark Angel half-brother to 9.4f/1m2f AW winner Siam Ruby (RPR 78); dam placed 7f AW 2yo (67), closely related to 7f 2yo winner Jacqueline Quest (relegated to second in 1,000 Guineas); likely to improve for this debut outing but is one to watch in the betting; has been gelded.
runners.comment: Likely to improve for this debut run but is one to watch in the betting; has been gelded

runners.name: Stormy Winter
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam French 11.5f/1m4f winner (RPR 74), sister to US 2m Grade 2 winner Siskany; Newmarket trainer has 4-19 (21%) record at Catterick; this Dark Angel newcomer could have a part to play.
runners.comment: First foal; dam French 11.5f/1m4f winner (RPR 74); could have a part to play on debut

runners.name: Darrington Golf
runners.spotlight: 5,000gns foal; towards the rear throughout when 33-1 for last month's debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm); lots of improvement is needed.
runners.comment: Towards the rear throughout when 33-1 for last month's debut at Doncaster

runners.name: Iconic Times
runners.spotlight: Following a two-month break he returned to form and landed a gamble in reapplied cheekpieces (retained) at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) last Thursday; he's never finished better than seventh on turf and the surface switch is a concern, but he'll be tough to beat if reproducing anything like his latest form.
runners.comment: Landed gamble on AW last Thursday; tough to beat if reproducing anything like that form

runners.name: Rain Cap
runners.spotlight: 9yo who has been beaten on his last 13 starts and hasn't really shone elsewhere on his last two outings; however, this four-time course winner was second in this last year and a respectable fourth over C&D three starts ago; could have a part to play now back here.
runners.comment: Beaten on last 13 starts but likes Catterick and could have a part to play now back here

runners.name: Our Hero Matty
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden who is unraced beyond 6f; after a promising third on stable debut here (6f, good to firm) in June he took a backward step when fifth at Beverley (5f, good to firm) latest, but this 3yo is not ruled out.
runners.comment: 13-race maiden who is unraced beyond 6f, but ran well here in June and is not ruled out

runners.name: Ziva's Star
runners.spotlight: She's run some respectable races this season but over shorter; 0-23 and hasn't been shaping as though a first win is imminent.
runners.comment: She's run some respectable races this season but 0-23 and others are preferred

runners.name: Wait For It
runners.spotlight: Remains a maiden after 14 starts but she's returned from a break in good form this summer, finishing in the first three on her last three starts (6f/7f, good/good to firm; including here); could be thereabouts.
runners.comment: 0-14 but she's returned from a break in good form this summer; could be thereabouts

runners.name: Without Delay
runners.spotlight: Two-time course winner who showed some spark when third over C&D in May; however, this 7yo has struggled on her four starts since and hopes are pinned on the first-time visor (replacing cheekpieces) prompting a revival.
runners.comment: Two-time course winner but hopes pinned on first-time visor prompting a revival

runners.name: Due Respect
runners.spotlight: A couple of respectable efforts in May/June but she's been well beaten on her last two starts and has won just one of her 24 races.
runners.comment: A couple of respectable efforts in May/June but well beaten on her last two starts

runners.name: Fleur De Mer
runners.spotlight: Both wins came on the AW in 2023 (8.5f/1m2f); bounced back from a lesser effort at Ayr (1m7f, soft) when a 3l fourth at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm) last time but she is yet to fully prove she's effective at this trip; visor goes on.
runners.comment: Both wins in 2023; bounced back from a lesser effort last time but 2m is a doubt; visor on
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs G F Hall Racing

runners.name: Lillistar
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 33 starts came on the AW at Wolverhampton (around 2m) in October; well-held third on her last two starts, including over C&D in May, but cheekpieces may be able to help; each-way chance.
runners.comment: One win from 33 starts; well-held third on her last two starts and cheekpieces now go on

runners.name: Slack Alice
runners.spotlight: In good form over hurdles, getting off the mark when winning at Market Rasen (2m7f) and just held on by a head to follow up at Stratford (2m6f) 36 days ago; ran respectably over this C&D for her previous stable and has claims returned to the Flat.
runners.comment: Has won her last two starts over hurdles; ran respectably here last year and holds claims

runners.name: Star Of Jupiter
runners.spotlight: 1-21, with the win coming in a classified event at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW; first-time blinkers) last February, but he has been runner-up on three occasions; below his best in recent starts and was last of four at Nottingham in June.
runners.comment: One win from 21 starts; below his best in recent starts and last of four last time

runners.name: Ruler Of The River
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over hurdles (2024/2025) when trained by Fergal O'Brien; tailed off here over 1m4f on her stable debut and she was an 11l fifth at Beverley (1m4f) a week ago; step back up in trip needs to help.
runners.comment: Dual winner over hurdles; well beaten over 1m4f in both starts for this yard

runners.name: Speechman
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner in France (1m/9.5f); beaten 13l when second of five over this C&D (good to firm) last month and was well beaten at Newcastle (2m, AW) four days ago; others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner in France over shorter; 13l second over C&D last month; well beaten latest

runners.name: Karthala
runners.spotlight: 16-race maiden (Flat/hurdles) but he was runner-up on the Flat at Yarmouth (1m4f, good; first-time cheekpieces) last October; has made the frame over hurdles in recent starts but others look stronger.
runners.comment: 16-race maiden (Flat/hurdles); has made the frame over hurdles in recent starts

runners.name: Free World
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on his first two starts for this stable (1m4f/1m6f) and he didn't see his race out when fourth of six at Nottingham (1m6f, good to firm) last month; down another 3lb but has stamina to prove for this far.
runners.comment: 0-6; didn't see his race out when fourth of six at Nottingham (1m6f); stamina to prove

runners.name: Zephlyn
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner last May, the most recent coming off a 7lb higher mark than today's; failed to beat a rival home here in May and he was pulled up over hurdles when last seen 52 days ago; bit to prove after those efforts.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner last May; last of five here in May and pulled up over hurdles 52 days ago

runners.name: Battenburg Belle
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the tenth attempt when getting up to win by a head over C&D in June; didn't get home over 7.5f at Beverley next time but ran well when third at Pontefract (6f) nine days ago; solid claims.
runners.comment: Won by a head over C&D in June and ran well when third at Pontefract nine days ago; solid

runners.name: Call Glory
runners.spotlight: 3-29 on the AW compared to 1-23 on turf, the last two successes coming at Southwell in January (6f/7f); went close at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) two weeks ago and will have no issue with the drop back in trip; respected.
runners.comment: 1-23 on turf but went close over 7f at Salisbury two weeks ago; respected down in trip

runners.name: Barmyblade
runners.spotlight: Made all at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) last month and bounced back from a disappointing effort when winning over this C&D two weeks ago (again made all); can't be dismissed off this 3lb higher mark at a track which suits.
runners.comment: Made all at Thirsk last month and over this C&D two weeks ago; 3lb higher; not dismissed

runners.name: Captain Cess
runners.spotlight: Ran well on his stable debut at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm) in June and built on that when winning at Thirsk (7f; fifth and sixth have won since) 19 days ago; this drop back in trip won't be an issue and he has good claims off a 4lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Built on his stable debut when winning over 7f at Thirsk last time; up 4lb; good claims

runners.name: Lucius Aurelius
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 21 starts came in a 5f handicap here in April off the same mark as today's but he's mostly struggled since; has failed to beat a rival on his last two outings and the headgear is now removed.
runners.comment: Sole win came here over 5f in April but he's mostly struggled since; headgear now removed
runners.owner: John Kelly, John McNeill & Kevin Mowatt

runners.name: Miss Rainbow
runners.spotlight: Often front-runner; course winner over 7f last June and gained her fifth success when winning at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) five starts ago; behind Barmyblade when third over this C&D before a lesser effort at Thirsk 11 days ago; could bounce back in this lower grade.
runners.comment: Course winner; behind Barmyblade when third over C&D before a lesser effort latest

runners.name: Enjoy The Night
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden; refused to settle and built up a clear lead at Beverley (7.5f, good to firm) three weeks ago, but was caught inside the final furlong and finished third of eight; there was plenty of encouragement to be taken from that effort and he should be suited by the drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Refused to settle and didn't get home over 7.5f at Beverley; drop back in trip will suit

runners.name: Howzak
runners.spotlight: Seven of his eight wins have been on the AW, the most recent coming at Newcastle (6f; first-time tongue-tie) in February; well beaten on his last three starts but he did have an excuse here two weeks ago (blindfold was removed late).
runners.comment: 1-8 on turf; well beaten on his last three starts but he did have an excuse here latest

runners.name: Hansteen
runners.spotlight: Went close when upped to 1m4f on his handicap debut at Ripon before winning a classified at Pontefract by 8l next time (made all); posted another good effort back in handicap company at Southwell (1m3f, AW) 12 days ago but is 5lb higher; makes the shortlist.
runners.comment: Has improved since stepping up in trip; 5lb higher than for his latest Southwell effort

runners.name: Muhib
runners.spotlight: 27-race maiden but he has been running well, including when a 8l second of seven behind Hansteen at Pontefract (1m4f, good to firm) 18 days ago; has a bit to find to reverse placings with that rival but holds each-way claims back into a handicap.
runners.comment: 0-27 but has been running well; 8l second behind Hansteen at Pontefract last time

runners.name: On The Bubble
runners.spotlight: 1-27 on Flat turf, the win coming on soft ground over 1m at Redcar in May 2024 (first-time hood); gave it a good go from the front when runner-up over this C&D last month but she failed to beat a rival home at Ayr (1m2f) two weeks ago; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Ran well over C&D two starts ago but failed to beat a rival home over 1m2f at Ayr latest

runners.name: Project Kinsman
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden whose best effort came when runner-up at Newcastle (1m2f) in April; well held when third of seven (beaten around 11l) over this C&D on her turf debut 13 days ago and others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: 0-8; best effort came on the AW in April; well held over this C&D on her turf debut latest

runners.name: Brunello Breeze
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been on the AW at Newcastle (1m2f/1m4f) and his best efforts on turf have been at Haydock; never dangerous at the former track over 1m2f in March and may need this first outing since.
runners.comment: All three wins on the AW at Newcastle but below his best there when last seen; may need it

runners.name: N'Ion
runners.spotlight: 3yo who was well beaten in his qualifying runs and it's been the same story in two handicaps, including at Southwell (1m3f, AW) last time after a 61-day break; others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: Well beaten in each of his five starts, two handicaps; others more persuasive

runners.name: Spirit Of Tokyo
runners.spotlight: Well beaten at triple-figure odds in three novice/maiden events at up to 1m and she did no better over C&D on her handicap/turf debut 13 days ago; better needed.
runners.comment: Well beaten in four starts at big prices, including on her handicap debut over C&D latest
runners.owner: The Tokyo Bay Syndicate And P Kirby

runners.name: Halimede
runners.spotlight: Well held in each of her three previous starts on the AW at around 1m in May and June; the hood worn for those outings is now removed, and it would be no surprise to see an improved performance now stepping up in trip on her turf/handicap debut (dam 1m3f-1m4f winner).
runners.comment: Steps up in trip for handicap debut and it would be no surprise to see an improved effort

runners.name: Havin A Flyer
runners.spotlight: Knocking on the door prior to getting off the mark at the 21st attempt at Southwell last month (5f, AW; made all); again ran well from the front when third of eight at Wolverhampton (5f, AW) last Thursday; she should be fine back on turf and could prove difficult to reel in.
runners.comment: Belatedly got off the mark at Southwell last month and could prove difficult to reel in

runners.name: Doralee
runners.spotlight: Her 23 starts have yielded just one win (last August) but she's edged back down the weights and was a head second of six at Ripon (5f, good to firm) last Monday; could be bang there today off the same mark.
runners.comment: Poor strike-rate but went close at Ripon last Monday; could again be bang there

runners.name: Brain Freeze
runners.spotlight: Won at Redcar (5f, good to firm) in May and good third at Ripon (5f, good) next time; she's back down to a handy mark but has gone off the boil on her last three starts; needs to get back on track in a first-time visor.
runners.comment: Won at Redcar in May but has gone off the boil on her last three starts; a visor goes on

runners.name: Gwen Tennyson
runners.spotlight: Promising third of six in C&D novice (good to firm) in May but unable to reproduce that form in her four handicaps, two of them over C&D.
runners.comment: Promising third in C&D novice in May but unable to reproduce that form in handicaps since

runners.name: Mimime
runners.spotlight: Made debut in May and well beaten on her three starts (6f, good to firm/AW); however, she now goes handicapping off a basement mark and has hinted that the drop to 5f will suit; one to watch in the betting.
runners.comment: Well beaten on first three runs but now goes handicapping off basement mark; watch betting

runners.name: Without Flaw
runners.spotlight: Made the frame a couple of times earlier this season and she's well handicapped on that form, but her last three performances haven't come up to scratch and she needs to raise her game.
runners.comment: On a reduced mark but her last three performances haven't come up to scratch

runners.name: Dunnington Lad
runners.spotlight: C&D winner but she's without a win since August 2024 and this season's performances suggest it's best to look elsewhere; a visor goes on.
runners.comment: No win since 2024 and this season's performances suggest it's best to look elsewhere

races.race_name: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle on Saturday, August 29th Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Tumbling In
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; decent efforts in defeat in two bumpers last year; better in two maiden hurdles this term, at Listowel (2m) and Killarney (2m7f); this trip should suit ideally and likely to be involved.
runners.comment: Good runs at Listowel (2m) and Killarney (2m7f); this trip should suit well; be involved
runners.owner: Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Goodmancon
runners.spotlight: Ran well at times in 10 bumpers without winning; the best of three maiden hurdle runs came when falling at Limerick last time when challenging two out; can be involved if none the worse for that.
runners.comment: Fell at Limerick last time when challenging; can be involved if none the worse for that

runners.name: Minella Moon Shine
runners.spotlight: Was in the process of running a big race on point debut in 2024 when falling; returned from a 791-day absence when just denied in a 2m maiden hurdle here last month; was keen that day but that freshness will need to be gone now up in trip; big player.
runners.comment: Just denied in a 2m maiden hurdle here last month; up in trip; big player if settling

runners.name: Boston Common
runners.spotlight: Showed a hint of ability in points but well beaten in a Wexford bumper on rules debut; can only be watched.
runners.comment: Showed a hint of ability in points but well beaten in a Wexford bumper on rules debut

runners.name: Maple Mornin
runners.spotlight: Tailed-off in a Sligo bumper on debut so can't be fancied now.
runners.comment: Tailed-off in a Sligo bumper on debut so can't be fancied

runners.name: Siege Of Milan
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; first foal; unraced dam closely related to bumper winners Megabill and No No Manolito, from the family of high-class staying chaser Therealbandit; unsold for E11,500 as a 3yo; late-starter will have to be smart to take this on debut>
runners.comment: Unsold for E11,500 as a 3yo; will have to be smart to take this on debut; reserve

runners.name: Star Cave
runners.spotlight: Placed in three of four point starts; ran a solid race in a 3m Cork maiden hurdle on rules debut last month; should have improved from that and tongue-tie worn that day retained.
runners.comment: Solid run in a 3m Cork maiden hurdle on rules debut; should have improved from that

runners.name: Carrigane
runners.spotlight: First reserve; some solid runs in points without winning; fine chase debut at Kilbeggan over this trip behind a decent rival; should have improved for that and can be a player if transferring that to hurdles.
runners.comment: Fine chase debut at Kilbeggan; can be a player if transferring that to hurdles; reserve

runners.name: Casper Charlie
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in a Punchestown festival bumper on debut but was running a sound race when falling in a C&D maiden hurdle last month; could be involved if jumping better.
runners.comment: Was running well when falling in a C&D maiden hurdle last month; could be involved

runners.name: Coral Reid
runners.spotlight: One of two runners for yard; E2,000 3yo; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Judicial Law (useful bumper and 2m-3m2f hurdle) and Camino Rocio (2m4f-3m chase); dam bumper/2m5f hurdle winner; related to some decent types but likely best watched on debut.
runners.comment: One of two runners for yard; related to some decent types but likely best watched on debut

runners.name: Louve d'Arc
runners.spotlight: Close fourth in a Galway bumper on debut last year but hasn't repeated that twice since; has to resume progress on hurdling debut.
runners.comment: Fourth in a Galway bumper on debut last year but hasn't repeated that twice since

runners.name: Xquise
runners.spotlight: Modest Flat maiden was soundly beaten in five hurdle starts in France and is best watched on return from an absence.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in five hurdle starts in France and best watched on return from an absence

runners.name: Installment
runners.spotlight: Much-improved effort when fourth in a Tramore maiden hurdle on comeback run but was pulled-up at Kilbeggan since so questions to answer now.
runners.comment: Fourth in a Tramore maiden hurdle on comeback run but was pulled-up at Kilbeggan since

runners.name: Ruled By The Sun
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability when beaten 14l in a Downpatrick bumper on second start; not easy to fancy after being pulled-up in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle since.
runners.comment: Not easy to fancy after being pulled-up in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last time

runners.name: Who's Going
runners.spotlight: Yard second-string; well beaten in three maiden hurdles in the spring and will be better off in handicaps.
runners.comment: Well beaten in three maiden hurdles in the spring and will be better off in handicaps

runners.name: Rodeo Joe
runners.spotlight: Little sign of ability in points and pulled-up in a Cork maiden hurdle last month; can't be fancied.
runners.comment: Little sign of ability in points and pulled-up in a Cork maiden hurdle last month

races.race_name: James Lohan Engineering Excellence Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Chantilly Wings
runners.spotlight: Some solid maiden hurdle form on good ground last summer; produced in good shape at Kilbeggan last month after a break; saddle slipped before the last, and he was worn down in the final strides despite his rider's best efforts; good run in the circumstances; leading chance.
runners.comment: Rider had to cope with a slipped saddle at Kilbeggan, fine effort in the circumstances

runners.name: Direct Approach
runners.spotlight: A 70-rated Flat maiden with Donnacha O'Brien last year; had two low-key runs in maiden hurdles before showing signs of progress when third at Kilbeggan 11 days ago; has the measure of Earthwatch on that evidence.
runners.comment: Fair third at Kilbeggan 11 days ago, has the measure of Earthwatch on that evidence

runners.name: Minella Hollow
runners.spotlight: Won two of his three bumper starts in 2024, including a 6l course win on good ground; ran only twice last year but remains of interest; stable had a winner on the Flat at Galway, jockey played a starring role during the week.
runners.comment: Won two of his three bumper starts in 2024, ran only twice last year, remains of interest

runners.name: Clay Pigeons
runners.spotlight: Joined Willie Mullins for E95,000euros after winning a point and 2m3f bumper at Cork, the latter for Emmet Mullins; backed that up in a bumper at Catterick (good to soft; first-time tongue-tie) on his first race for the champion trainer; costly failure over 2m4f at Fakenham in January on hurdling debut; ought to be capable of much better than that.
runners.comment: Point winner, 2-2 in bumpers, costly failure over 2m4f at Fakenham on hurdling debut
runners.owner: Aisling Byrne & Paul Raleigh & Matthew Cunningham

runners.name: Prophetess Miriam
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two bumpers at Listowel and Punchestown last autumn; midfield in her first two starts in maiden hurdles; might be one for handicaps after this.
runners.comment: Fair placed form in bumpers, has not yet shown a similar standard of form over hurdles

runners.name: Goeasyonme
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; second foal; Montmartre gelding; dam runner-up on the Flat in France, half-sister to a French chase winner.
runners.comment: Third reserve; Montmartre gelding, dam placed on the Flat, half-sister to a  chase winner

runners.name: Ataboymiley
runners.spotlight: First reserve; Eleventh foal; half-brother by sprinter Pearl Secret to five winners; dam stayed well, closely related to 6f Group 2 winner The Kiddykid.
runners.comment: First reserve, half-brother by sprinter Pearl Secret to five winners; dam stayed well

runners.name: William F Browne
runners.spotlight: Two Flat wins in 2024; unplaced in three Flat handicaps last month; not disgraced when set a very stiff task in a Galway novice hurdle, 300-1 outsider then, fifth of nine finishers behind the exciting Witches Familiar.
runners.comment: Two Flat wins in 2024, not disgraced when set a very stiff task in a Galway novice hurdle

runners.name: Glenmore Graduate
runners.spotlight: No promise in points; down the field in a bumper; tailed off in a Killarney maiden hurdle.
runners.comment: No promise in points, down the field in a bumper, tailed off in a Killarney maiden hurdle

runners.name: Leva Deva
runners.spotlight: Two runs at Sligo, pulled up in a maiden hurdle and tailed off in a bumper.
runners.comment: Two runs at Sligo, pulled up in a maiden hurdle and tailed off in a bumper

runners.name: Saviour Blu
runners.spotlight: No sign of ability in two hurdle outings at this venue, in rear in a bumper at Ballinrobe two weeks ago; hooded now.
runners.comment: No sign of ability in two hurdle outings at this venue, in rear in a bumper at Ballinrobe

runners.name: Kilmond Knight
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in a point; has been let down by his jumping at Ballinrobe on his first two hurdle runs.
runners.comment: Pulled up in a point, has been let down by his jumping on his first two hurdle runs

runners.name: Haughty
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m handicap on good ground at Salisbury in 2023; has shown nothing in Ireland; poor recent Flat form; can be discounted.
runners.comment: Won a 1m handicap in Britain in 2023, has shown nothing in Ireland, poor recent Flat form

runners.name: Le Roi Arthur
runners.spotlight: Stepped up from his form in points when third in a maiden hurdle at Sligo last summer; absent since unplaced in a bumper at Navan last September.
runners.comment: Third in a maiden hurdle last summer; absent since unplaced in a bumper last September.

runners.name: Sound Judgement
runners.spotlight: Point winner and bumper-placed; twice a beaten favourite over hurdles after chasing home the useful Galileo Dame in a 2m maiden at Navan in February; the addition of cheekpieces and a step up to 3m did the trick when she won a 3m maiden at Cork last month; left on the same mark, fom boosted when the third Jereoboam Machin ran well at Galway.
runners.comment: Stayed well when winning a maiden at Cork in first-time cheekpieces, left on the same mark

runners.name: She'll Be Kept
runners.spotlight: Fair placed form in points last season, though not progressive; hinted at winning potential with a staying-on sixth behind today's rival Sallap at Limerick early last month; came good in emphatic style when running out an 8l winner from Smackwater Jack (second reserve) at Ballinrobe two weeks ago; raised 11lb, may remain competitive.
runners.comment: Only sixth behind Sallap at Limerick, emphatic winner at Ballinrobe, raised 11l

runners.name: Smackwater Jack
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; has backed up a surprise Punchestown win with two solid runs in defeat; veteran clearly retains enough ability to make his presence felt.
runners.comment: Second reserve, has backed up a surprise Punchestown win with two solid runs in defeat

runners.name: Mr Dibbs
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner at Kilbeggan two seasons ago; second in a Sligo handicap last August off this mark; poor form in three points last October/November; jumped poorly and pulled up on return to hurdling at Kilbeggan in April; back to form in first-time blinkers at Sligo in May, winning narrowly despite an untidy round of jumping; has changed stable.
runners.comment: Won narrowly at Sligo in May despite an untidy round of jumping, up 5lb, change of stable

runners.name: Knocknagoran Lady
runners.spotlight: Had plenty to spare when scoring a breakthrough win over an extended 2m6f at Limerick; a wind operation seems to have done the trick, and she was able to defy a 9lb rise when scoring readily at Kilbeggan; has gone up by the same amount again, fair prospects of completing a hat-trick.
runners.comment: Has turned the corner since a wind operation, has fair prospects of completing a hat-trick

runners.name: Mavetherave
runners.spotlight: Placed twice in maiden hurdles; has failed to make much impact in three handicap attempts; finished behind Mephisto on stable debut at Bellewstown.
runners.comment: Placed twice in maiden hurdles, has failed to make much impact in three handicap attempts

runners.name: Glitz And Glamour
runners.spotlight: Sligo maiden hurdle winner last August; made three undistinguished appearances over fences before reverting to hurdles at Cork last time; should be sharper for the run; worth market check.
runners.comment: Reverted to hurdles at Cork last time, should be sharper for the run, worth a market check

runners.name: Its Not Over Yet
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; won twice in 2024, including over C&D (soft); seemed to be heading back to form when third at Listowel in June; dropped away tamely when one of the main fancies in a C&D handicap last month.
runners.comment: Third reserve, C&D winner in 2024, faded tamely when well fancied here last month

runners.name: Itsaworkinmaniam
runners.spotlight: Won on his second point start in May 2025; best of four maiden hurdle runs when a 16l runner-up to the useful County Final in a 2m3f contest at Navan last September; tongue-tie now on for his first appearance since the following month.
runners.comment: Chased home a useful sort at Navan last September, first run after a break, tongue-tie on

runners.name: Kalanisi Flash
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner over 2m6f over two years ago; has only run four times since; pulled up on his last three starts, two of them over hurdles in recent months.
runners.comment: Pulled up on his last three starts, safe to leave out of calculations

runners.name: Mephisto
runners.spotlight: Completed a hat-trick of handicap hurdle wins during a short time frame last August; went up an aggregate 23lb for victories at Wexford, Ballinrobe and Tramore; has tended to struggle since then; fair fourth at Bellewstown early last month, out of the money at Downpatrick and last week at Galway.
runners.comment: In terrific form when completing a hat-trick last August, hard to fancy on recent form

runners.name: Getaway Charlie
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run since winning a Punchestown handicap in 2023; heavy defeats in two handicap hurdles in April; remote fourth in a C&D claimer last month.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats in two handicap hurdles in April; remote fourth in a C&D claimer last month

runners.name: It's Not His Fault
runners.spotlight: Not a bad run when third on debut at Tipperary last October, though beaten in excess of 20l; down the field in two subsequent maiden outings and tailed off in a handicap at Thurles in March; good ground should see him perform to better effect.
runners.comment: Best run was on debut, good ground may suit, trainer also runs Glitz And Glamour

runners.name: Priory Park
runners.spotlight: Won four times in points during the 2024 autumn campaign; has brought his racecourse tally to four with two successes since then; started well for this stable with a handicap hurdle win at Ballinrobe last September, hard to fancy on subsequent form.
runners.comment: Won a handicap hurdle win at Ballinrobe last September, hard to fancy on subsequent form

runners.name: Starzov
runners.spotlight: Has won twice over hurdles, including a course maiden success 2022; no sign of his best form in a five-race campaign between May and August last year.
runners.comment: No sign of his best form in a five-race campaign between May and August last year

runners.name: Hashtag Pretender
runners.spotlight: Placed in both chase starts last year; second behind Downmexicoway at Killarney and a 5l third behind Birdie Or Bust at Listowel; 9-2 for handicap chase bow at Punchestown on seasonal return when fell early; probably the one to beat if that hasn't dented his confidence.
runners.comment: Placed twice over fences last year, fell at Punchestown, the one to beat with clear round

runners.name: Impero
runners.spotlight: By far the most talented of these over hurdles (rated 140) and he jumped accurately before tiring on his chase debut at Kilbeggan over 2m4f; nowhere near as good dropped back to 2m (good) at Wexford on latest and questions to answer now.
runners.comment: Talented hurdler, okay start over fences at Kilbeggan, not as good at Wexford latest

runners.name: Killeemore Lad
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose sort; rated 112 over hurdles; was returning from a 745 day layoff at Wexford 13 days ago when making his chase debut and was in the process of running a cracker before falling at the last; sharper for that and can go well once this doesn't come too soon.
runners.comment: Running well when falling at the last on chase bow after long absence, sharper now

runners.name: Orkneys Jack
runners.spotlight: Winning pointer rated just 90 over hurdles but was an encouraging 6.5l third on his chase debut, keeping on over 2m4f (yielding) at Kilbeggan and earning an RPR of 117; weakened when upped to 25.5f back there latest and now drops markedly back in trip; this may be too sharp a test.
runners.comment: Rated 90 over hurdles, RPR of 117 on chase bow at Kilbeggan (2m4f), this trip a query

runners.name: Silent Selector
runners.spotlight: Is 2-12 over hurdles and rated 99; ran to an RPR of 111 when a 13.75l fifth of 11 on his chase debut in a beginners' at Wexford (19.5f, good), fading late on after making most of the running; worth a go at this shorter trip on that evidence; place claims.
runners.comment: Rated 99 over hurdles, ok effort on chase bow at Wexford, place chance on that run

runners.name: Piccolo Player
runners.spotlight: Is 1-10 over hurdles and rated 104; two runs over fences; beaten 23l in a handicap chase over this C&D in January off 105; remote third behind progressive Shadow Paddy at Killarney latest; needs to improve plenty on those efforts to take this.
runners.comment: 104 rated hurdler, no match for Shadow Paddy on latest, improvement needed

runners.name: Swing Time
runners.spotlight: Nine race maiden over hurdles and rated just 78; pulled up at Fairyhouse when last seen in November and can only be watched on seasonal return and chase debut.
runners.comment: Modest hurdler, pulled up when last seen in November, best watched on chase debut

runners.name: Island McCoo
runners.spotlight: Chase winner at Tramore last year; won over hurdles at Kilbeggan in June and shrugged off a lesser run there next time to be a solid fourth chasing last time; a player up 1lb.
runners.comment: Won over hurdles at Kilbeggan and a solid fourth there chasing last time; a player up 1lb

runners.name: Jouster
runners.spotlight: Won two races over hurdles plus a chase in a productive 2024 but has been regressive since, mostly over fences; needs a revival.
runners.comment: Won two races over hurdles plus a chase in a productive 2024 but has been regressive since

runners.name: Ladies Well
runners.spotlight: Hurdle winner at Ballinrobe in 2025 got off the mark over fences at Killarney (2m7f) last time in ready fashion; raised 8lb but should be a major player again.
runners.comment: Got off the mark over fences at Killarney last time; raised 8lb but a major player again

runners.name: King's Son
runners.spotlight: Maiden has posted decent efforts on two of last three chase starts, at Downpatrick and Wexford; needs more but down 2lb a help and blinkers are added.
runners.comment: Decent efforts on two of last three chase starts but needs more; down 2lb a help

runners.name: Rideau Canal
runners.spotlight: Won at Thurles in testing ground in February but has been nowhere near that level since so others preferred.
runners.comment: Won at Thurles in testing ground in February but nowhere near that level since

runners.name: Gaoithe Glory
runners.spotlight: Maiden has run well enough in defeat at times but best efforts have been on soft ground so rain would help.
runners.comment: Has run well enough in defeat at times but best efforts have been on soft ground

runners.name: Ballyredinkingston
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden over hurdles did show some spark in points early in career but still isn't easy to fancy on chasing debut.
runners.comment: Regressive maiden over hurdles isn't easy to fancy on chasing debut

runners.name: Another Challenge
runners.spotlight: Maiden was runner-up at Down Royal over Christmas but was poor on return at Limerick in May so has to rebound.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Down Royal over Christmas but poor on return so has to rebound

runners.name: Johnny M
runners.spotlight: Maiden has been poor over hurdles and fences lately so isn't easy to make a case for.
runners.comment: Maiden has been poor over hurdles and fences lately so isn't easy to make a case for

runners.name: Max Time
runners.spotlight: Not a bad hurdle run last time, albeit still beaten 21l; however, little sign of winning potential in four chase starts; others preferred.
runners.comment: Not a bad hurdle run last time but little sign of winning potential in four chase starts

runners.name: Full Noise
runners.spotlight: Sole hurdle win came in January 2022; cheekpieces tried on first run since July 2024 and debut for a new yard; best watched unbless the market suggests otherwise.
runners.comment: Makes debut for a new yard; best watched unbless the market suggests otherwise

runners.name: Tantrum Boy
runners.spotlight: His best run over hurdles when came when fourth at Ballinrobe last time over a similar trip to this; has a shout if he can repeat that effort now chasing.
runners.comment: Best run over hurdles when 4th at Ballinrobe last time; a shout with a repeat now chasing

runners.name: Doyen Wolf
runners.spotlight: Maiden has had only sevem rules runs in an interrupted career; best effort over hurdles came at Sligo last time; can go well if repeating that over fences.
runners.comment: Best run over hurdles came at Sligo last time; can go well if repeating that over fences

runners.name: Il Silenzio
runners.spotlight: Won this race a year ago; didn't appear again until a solid fourth off this mark at Punchestown in June; should be involved if in the same form.
runners.comment: Won this race a year ago; fourth at Punchestown in June; be involved if in the same form

runners.name: Love Like This
runners.spotlight: First reserve; is 1-34 over hurdles and 0-11 over fences; well beaten last time at Kilbeggan.
runners.comment: Is 1-34 over hurdles and 0-11 over fences; well beaten last time at Kilbeggan; reserve

runners.name: Oogum Boogum
runners.spotlight: Punchestown handicap hurdle winner ran well in defeat between that sphere and chasing next three starts; disappointing over fences last time and blinkers replace cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Hurdle winner was disappointing over fences last time and blinkers replace cheekpieces

runners.name: Sampoet
runners.spotlight: Point winner is a maiden under 14 rules starts between hurdles and fences; however, would have a squeak if building on his Downpatrick chase fourth in June.
runners.comment: Maiden would have a squeak if building on his Downpatrick chase fourth in June

runners.name: Kilkee Bay
